title: Useful product!
text:
Useful product!. Much more substantial of a product than I was expecting for the price!
Allows the sponge to breathe and dry quicker, so theres less stinky stink mildew.
Suction cups are quality -- thick and strong.

product_metadata.title: Spectrum Diversified Ashley Sponge Holder, Satin Nickel
features: CHANNEL YOUR MODERN CLASSIC STYLE: Celebrate form, function, and style with one uniform look. The modern lines and classic finishes create a traditional appearance with modern flair. Designed to coordinate with a variety of kitchen fixtures

STYLISH SINK ORGANIZATION: Organize your sink accessories and cleaning utensils for easy access. Don’t misplace your kitchen sponge or dish brush; give them a place to live permanently, so you always know where these kitchen essentials are located

CLEANER SPONGES: As your sponge dries, water drains into the sink, keeping your countertops clean and dry. Open wire design encourages the dishwashing accessories and cleaning supplies to dry fully, minimizing bacteria growth

SECURE SUCTION CUPS: Secure sponge cradle and dish brush holder to the side of your sink with suction cups. Clean the suction cup and the inside of the sink to remove residue, which may inhibit suction. Press the suction cup for a secure seal

DIMENSIONS & CARE: 4.75" L X 2.5" W X 3" H; to clean, wipe with a damp cloth and towel dry. Do not place in the dishwasher. Please wait 24 hours for the suction cup to seal tightly before placing weight in the sponge holder
description: Add extra storage to your kitchen sink with the Ashley Suction Sink Sponge Holder from Spectrum Diversified. Organize your sink accessories and cleaning utensils for easy access. Don’t misplace your kitchen sponge or dish brush; give them a place to live permanently, so you always know where these kitchen essentials are located. As your sponge dries, water drains into the sink, keeping your countertops clean and dry. Open wire design encourages the dishwashing accessories and cleaning supplies to dry fully, minimizing bacteria growth. Perfect for holding a sponge or bar of soap, its open design provides optimal drainage while two strong suction cups firmly adhere to most smooth surfaces. The sponge holder’s clean and classic design will add a contemporary touch to your home. Celebrate form, function, and style with one uniform look. The modern lines and classic finishes create a traditional appearance with modern flair. Designed to coordinate with a variety of kitchen fixtures. Secure sponge cradle and dish brush holder to the side of your sink with suction cups. Clean the suction cup and the inside of the sink to remove residue, which may inhibit suction. Press the suction cup for a secure seal. Please wait 24 hours for the suction cup to seal tightly before placing weight in the sponge holder. Do not place in the dishwasher. Made of sturdy steel.
